tab.description: The tab the command acted on.

status.description: The HTTP status of the main document; absent for same-document navigations, history entries served from cache without a response, `file:` and `about:` urls, and `wait_until: none`.

page_generation.description: The tab's page generation: it grows when the main frame navigates or the document is replaced (DOM.documentUpdated). Refs are valid only in the generation that issued them.

console_errors.description: Console errors (console.error, uncaught exceptions, failed loads the browser logged) during the navigation.

timed_out.description: `wait_until` was not reached in `wait_ms`; the page may still be loading.
